summary: Flat dip on a quiet residential street, homes 11-14 m off.

best_section.where: Low point of Rennie Street, north kerb opposite the grassy verge

drivers.seclusion: Houses 11-14 m from the kerb on this side; no bush or open space.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along it; room at the kerb.
drivers.convention: Residents park along the kerb, but no overnight camping convention.

sun_shade: Tree canopy shades much of this kerb, mainly from the north.
